title: Grilled Tofu Skewers with Sriracha Sauce
description: This grilled tofu skewers with Sriracha sauce recipe features tofu and veggies marinated in Sriracha, soy sauce, sesame oil, onion, and jalapeño.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) container extra firm tofu, drained and sliced into large chunks
1 red bell pepper, cut into large chunks

steps.text: Place tofu, mushrooms, zucchini, and bell pepper in a bowl. Combine soy sauce, onion, Sriracha, sesame oil, jalapeño, and black pepper in a small bowl; pour over tofu-vegetable mixture and toss lightly to coat. Cover the bowl; marinate tofu and vegetables in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat, and lightly oil the grate.
Thread tofu and vegetables onto skewers; reserve marinade.
Cook on the preheated grill until desired doneness, about 10 minutes. Serve remaining marinade as a dipping sauce.

video.description: Whether you’re looking for something tasty for Meatless Monday or an economical way to fire up the grill for summertime cooking, these grilled tofu skewers will surprise and satisfy you with their nutritious ingredients and great flavor. Simply stir up a marinade of sriracha, soy sauce, sesame oil, onion, jalapeno and black pepper, then pour over chunks of extra firm tofu, zucchini, red bell pepper and mushroom. Grill and enjoy!
